title: Nice app, some suggestions
body:
This app has helped me finish school projects and build on hobbies, which i really appreciate. I like how you can make widgets on iphone to keep you reminded of what you want to do, and that you can make habits for each week instead of each day, i like the streaks. The app still needs some improvement though, so here i list some suggestions:

1. Dissapearing Streaks: The streak feature keeps me motivated, but the streaks don’t dissappear if you didn’t complete your habit for the day/week, which makes the whole point of the streak useless. Even if i don’t finish one day or one week my goal, the streak stays there, just doesn’t go up, and i feel like if the streak dissappeared if i don’t accomplish my goal, it would push me and motivate me to finish it. This should be added as an optional feature for each habit though, as to not discourage people who like their streaks as they are.

2. 1.5 Hour goals: Give the option to choose goals for an hour and a half, or an hour and some minutes: it’s really annoying because i want to change a goal from 3 hours a week to 3 and a half hours per week but if i did that i would loose my 32 week streak, which is really stupid. It’s stupid you have to either choose 3 hours, and if u want 3 and a half hours you have to change the measuring to minutes and put 210 minutes in, which deleted all previous progress.

3. Mini-Goals: It would be really nice if i could make a bullet point list of what i want to accomplish that week in a specific habit, for example, i have one goal which is study for school, and i would like to be able to list what things i have to get done that week and check them off along as i track my time, instead of using another app to annotate stuff.

4. Perfect weeks and months instead of perfect days: I really like the perfect day tracking feature, but as i use the weekly habits way more, my only „perfect“ days are sundays, when i finish all my goals. I would like to see my perfect weeks and how much percent of weeks were perfect, because even though i finish almost all my goals every week, i only have a 55% score on perfect days which is sad. On top of that, my daily average is 0, which is dumb because i track all of my habits on a weekly basis. 

I am paying for the premium version which i think it’s kinda worth it considering i use more than 5 habits, but all these errors feel really dumb and easy to correct. If the developers made an update correcting all of these id gladly give 5 stars, because this app has helped me get my life together for school, and spend less time on my phone and actually doing something constructive, but some of these errors mentioned above are really annoying.

body:
Great app for tracking habits!

The only issue is that there is some kind of bug on the overview page for a habit (with calendar and records statistic). Sometimes I forget to mark the habit as done during the day, so I go to the calendar and mark it there. While I am on the page the calendar is updated with my new entries, but if I leave the habit and then return to it, updated entries are gone. Also the number of days in the statistic is not updated. This behavior is inconsistent though, sometimes I am lucky and all new entries are saved, sometimes part of new records are saved and sometimes none of them.
